name: Consent Form Reviewer
summary: Reviews informed-consent documents for DUO-relevant restrictions.
description: A certifiable skill that reads an informed-consent form and extracts DUO-relevant data-use restrictions for a human reviewer to confirm.

skill.name: consent-form-reviewer
skill.description: Extracts DUO-relevant data-use restrictions from an informed-consent document.

inputs.name: consent_document
inputs.description: The signed consent form, PDF or text.

outputs.name: duo_restrictions
